assessments.reasoning: Paragraph 14/1 establishes the bounded error. Paragraph 15 selects the assignment-triggered Finalize branch and raises Program_Error at that point.

challenge.method: Compare the assignment Finalize branch with Adjust, Unchecked_Deallocation and a finalization triggered by another transfer of control under §7.6.1(16/5–20).
challenge.results: Later branches may perform remaining finalizations before Program_Error or ignore the exception in a specified abort case. The frozen trigger requires an actual Finalize call that propagated. Any permitted hook omission is outside that trigger.

limitations: This selects the stated case only. Propagation from Adjust and from finalization invoked by a master has separately specified consequences. The claim supplies no guarantee that an implementation performs every otherwise permitted-to-omit hook.
Exact unannotated Ada 2022 manual edition only. Runtime implementations and other editions require separate evidence.
